lines.zh: 我在殿里踱步，尾巴垂着。
lines.en: I pace the hall, my tail hanging low.

lines.zh: 靴跟敲在石板上，一声一声。
lines.en: My heels click on the stone, one by one.

lines.zh: 我走得不快，谁也不敢挡。
lines.en: I walk slowly, and no one dares block me.

lines.zh: 这根尾巴先扫开路上的灰。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the dust from my path.
This building is where I hold court and teach.
I smooth the armor on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我的步子极轻，落地无声。
lines.en: My steps are light and silent.
Frost demons do not sweat; we walk.

lines.zh: 我绕过长桌，检视你们的坐姿。
lines.en: I circle the table and inspect how you sit.

lines.zh: 我走到窗边，看天殿的云。
lines.en: I walk to the window and watch the clouds.
My white armor gives off a chill.

lines.zh: 我踱到你身后，再绕回来。
lines.en: I pace behind you, then come round again.

lines.zh: 每一步都像在数你的错处。
lines.en: Each step seems to count your mistakes.
I stop on the highest step.
I stay still and the air cools.
I tap the armrest with one finger.
I am reckoning how long you still must train.
A frost demon has no need to sit.

lines.zh: 我闭眼，气在体内转了圈。
lines.en: I close my eyes and my ki circles within.

lines.zh: 教室里太吵，我抬了抬眉。
lines.en: The hall is too loud; I raise an eyebrow.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在空中画了个圈。
lines.en: My tail traces a circle in the air.
I wait for someone to dare speak first.

lines.zh: 这具身体不会老，只会无聊。
lines.en: This body never ages, only grows bored.
I clasp my hands behind me and stay silent.

lines.zh: 一根柱子挡住了我的视线。
lines.en: A pillar is blocking my line of sight.

lines.zh: 我又想起自己教过多少人了。
lines.en: I wonder how many I have taught.
My ki is held in tightly.

lines.zh: 安静是这里最好的规矩。
lines.en: Silence is the best rule in this hall.

lines.zh: 你的气很弱，但形状不错。
lines.en: Your ki is weak, but well shaped.
Speak with your head up; stop watching the floor.
That frame of yours can be trained.
I am a master, not a target.
What do you want to learn? Say it plainly.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱，站桩先站好。
lines.en: Your breathing is scattered; fix your stance first.

lines.zh: 我教的东西，你未必受得住。
lines.en: You may not be able to bear what I teach.
I have your face now, student.
That small confidence of yours interests me.

lines.zh: 别用这种眼神，我不吃这套。
lines.en: Don't look at me like that; it does not work.
Your fist is loose; close it.

lines.zh: 量过你的气，我才决定教什么。
lines.en: I measure your ki before I decide what to teach.
That outfit says you come from outside.
You smell of having fought.
Do not cut in while I am speaking.
Stand in the light; let me see you.
You dared strike me, student.
This pain is not even a warm-up.
My armor took most of that for you.
Back off; you have overstepped.
My brow twitches; that is all.

lines.zh: 教你的东西，你用在师长身上？
lines.en: You use my lessons on your teacher?

lines.zh: 我的气没有乱，你的乱了。
lines.en: My ki is undisturbed; yours is not.
Strike again and the lesson ends.

lines.zh: 这具身体只有一百点血，别浪费。
lines.en: This body has only a hundred points; do not waste them.

lines.zh: 我不为食物动摇，收起它。
lines.en: I am not moved by food; put it away.

lines.zh: 这点东西，也想换我的课？
lines.en: You think that buys my lesson?
I glance at it and lose interest.

lines.zh: 你若想拜师，拿的是诚意。
lines.en: To be my student, bring sincerity.
I raise a hand for you to take it back.
Frost demons do not eat such things.
The smell is offensive; take it away.
Raise it higher; I still will not look.
Trade it for completed lessons and I may nod.

lines.zh: 我的兴趣只在你的进步。
lines.en: My interest lies only in your progress.
You bumped me; step back three paces.
My armor is harder than you think.
That bump should leave your wrist sore.
I do not move; you wobble.
I step aside out of courtesy, nothing more.
Touching me counts as nerve.
You jostle your teacher in his own hall?

lines.zh: 我们各退一步，到此为止。
lines.en: We each step back; that is the end of it.
My tail bars the way in front of you.
I do not discuss such things, student.

lines.zh: 冰冻恶魔的血脉，不由这种话决定。
lines.en: Frost demon bloodlines are not settled by such talk.
Your mind is in the wrong place.
I take students, nothing else.
I raise an eyebrow; you should stop.

lines.zh: 这问题不配在这殿里问。
lines.en: That question does not belong in this hall.
My time goes to teaching.
Go train; put that out of your head.
I turn and look out the window.
Ask again and I will make you hold a stance.
I bend and pick up that badge.
This fell in my hall.
I pinch it between my fingertips.
It is so light it hardly weighs anything.
I set it straight on the table.
Whoever dropped it, come claim it.
I look at it, then toss it back.

lines.zh: 灰尘沾在我指尖，我弹掉。
lines.en: Dust clings to my fingers; I flick it away.
This thing carries your scent.
Keep track of your belongings, student.

lines.zh: 我锁定你的气，看你几斤几两。
lines.en: I lock onto your ki to weigh you.
Stand still; I will measure your foundation.

lines.zh: 你出招前，我已经看穿了。
lines.en: I saw through you before you moved.
My gaze is on you; do not flinch.

lines.zh: 这么近的距离，你藏不住气。
lines.en: At this range you cannot hide your ki.
I have called your name; step up.
I raise a hand toward the center of the floor.
Your weight is on the right; I know it.
This lesson begins with taking a hit.
I watch you until you strike.
Your ki is trembling; steady it.

lines.zh: 我跟着你绕场，一步不差。
lines.en: I circle the floor with you, step for step.
You back to the wall; I am still watching.
Don't rush in; watch my feet first.

lines.zh: 我缓慢移动，逼你找角度。
lines.en: I move slowly, forcing you to find an angle.
Your left shoulder rose; I noticed.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，你却越来越慌。
lines.en: I stand still and you grow more flustered.

lines.zh: 再拖下去，你的气就散了。
lines.en: Delay longer and your ki will disperse.
I gesture for you to continue.
Your footwork is a mess; again.

lines.zh: 我出手示范，只用一分力。
lines.en: I demonstrate, using a fraction of my strength.

lines.zh: 这一掌停在离你一寸处。
lines.en: This palm stops an inch from you.
Did you see? The elbow tucks like this.
A light push and you are back.
You miss because I did not move.
My punch is light, but the angle is cruel.
Again; turn your hips out.
You blocked it, better than last time.
I withdraw; your breathing is too fast.
That is enough for today; go practise.

lines.zh: 我站在这殿中央，等学生来。
lines.en: I stand at the center of the hall, waiting.

lines.zh: 这具身体由结构与指令放置。
lines.en: This body is placed by structure or command.

lines.zh: 我从冰封的气里睁开眼。
lines.en: I open my eyes out of frozen ki.

lines.zh: 白甲已经穿好，尾巴也稳。
lines.en: White armor on, tail steady.

lines.zh: 这地方的光太软，我不习惯。
lines.en: The light here is too soft for my taste.
My lessons are never late.
No one around; good, it is quiet.
I scan the room once.
The students should be arriving.
I lift a hand, then lower it.

lines.zh: 火气掠过我的甲，没留下痕。
lines.en: Flame washes my armor and leaves no mark.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上落下，落地很稳。
lines.en: I drop from the steps and land cleanly.

lines.zh: 水浸到我的甲缝里，很不快。
lines.en: Water seeps into my armor seams; unpleasant.
The blast costs me half a step, only half.
A dart sticks in my shoulder; childish.

lines.zh: 这股术法想进我的气，失败。
lines.en: That spell tries to enter my ki and fails.

lines.zh: 我不靠进食活着，只是虚。
lines.en: I do not live by eating, but I feel hollow.

lines.zh: 雷电绕过我的甲，钻进来一点。
lines.en: Lightning skirts my armor and slips a little in.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我仍不慌。
lines.en: Nothing underfoot, and still I am calm.
